claim: On neutral_hostile_v1/09_ml_artifacts, reconstructing the exact same DGO1 delimiter record into one contiguous bytearray using CPython extended-slice scatter reduces delimiter inverse wall time by 48.6% versus the canonical Python inverse, while preserving byte-for-byte output and archive integrity and adding no third-party runtime dependency.

decision.reason: The exact dependency-free arm recovers nearly half of delimiter inverse wall time and does so through only 516 C-level strided scatter operations for 1,002,598 active cells. Together with the gifted-vector oracle's 85.6% reduction, this confirms that per-segment Python object/layout work is a material causal owner and that a standard-library realization captures substantial headroom without importing NumPy into the product.
decision.promotion_boundary: This remains one-record research evidence and grants zero release credit. Promotion requires installing the exact algorithm in the canonical release reader, proving hostile/exact transform equivalence, and rerunning complete-product runtime/RSS, reader/recovery/native/platform and release authority on one fingerprint.
decision.next_action: Promote the dependency-free one-buffer inverse into the canonical release-only DGO1 path, retaining the preserved historical inverse as an independent byte oracle, then measure complete-product effects before making any release claim.

scope: One-record, one-workload research oracle. It establishes a practical implementation candidate, not complete-product performance.
